description: Search for emails matching criteria and delete them all. Useful for cleaning up spam or unwanted emails. At least one concrete criterion (from, to, subject, before, or since) is REQUIRED — a call with no criteria is refused so it can never wipe an entire folder. Supports dryRun to preview matches first.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

chunkSize.description: Number of emails to delete per batch

dryRun.description: If true, only return what would be deleted without actually deleting

name: imap_bulk_delete_by_search
